text: This is the most affordable OLED monitor you can get here on TikTok. The Acer Predator 27-inch 240Hz OLED that comes in at 1440p, and the visuals on this monitor look so insane with the True Blacks. And since it is QD OLED instead of Wo-LED, it's really going to deliver those more vivid and punchy colors. Whether you use this thing for Photoshop or Premiere Pro or, of course, gaming, you're really going to be able to experience those graphics at the highest level. But unfortunately, OLEDs are prone to burning, so it deterred me from purchasing one for a long time because most of them go for over like $500, but the Predator goes for under $320, and it has pixel cleaning too, so you don't even have to worry about that. With Best Buy being on TikTok Shop now, this was the obvious choice because it's already so affordable, but with Black Friday rolling around, there's bound to be a bunch of deals and coupons and whatnot, so if you still see the link down below, it does mean you can get your hands on this.
